name: explore
description_en: Community-curated topic and collection pages on GitHub
readme_excerpt: GitHub Explore This repository houses all of the community-curated content for GitHub Topics and Collections. Topics help you explore repositories in a particular subject area, learn more about that subject, and find projects to contribute to. Collections help you discover hand-picked repositories, developers, organizations, videos, and articles that share a common theme.
